meta_description: Separate Bank Account Required for Maharashtra RERA Projects Registered After 1st July 2024 - Real Estate Learn about the Maharashtra RERA order dated 1st July 2024, mandating separate bank accounts for registered real estate projects to ensure proper fund utilization and transparency. Explore how this regulation promotes financial discipline and protects the interests of homebuyers.
body_html: The Maharashtra RERA order dated 1st July 2024 requires promoters of newly registered real estate projects to maintain a separate bank account for each project. This measure ensures that 70% of the funds collected from allottees are exclusively used for the specific project, enhancing transparency and financial discipline. Non-compliance could result in penalties and legal consequences.
